transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Ever since they changed everything at school, I feel like I’m not handling it well at all and my reactions to the stress are taking over my life. It has just gotten to the point where I feel completely overwhelmed, and I realized I need some help to get through this.

Did these feelings of being overwhelmed begin specifically in response to the recent changes at school, or have you been experiencing these symptoms of anxiety and low mood in other areas of your life as well?

Yes, this all started specifically within a few weeks of them announcing the school restructuring and moving me to the new classroom. Before all of this, I was my usual, grounded self, but now the stress is spilling over into my home life. I've been snapping at my husband and skipping family gatherings because I just feel so drained.
Beyond feeling drained and irritable, have these symptoms caused you significant distress or difficulty managing your daily responsibilities, such as your schoolwork or household chores?

Yes, it has made managing my daily life incredibly difficult. My lesson planning has slowed down so much that I have to stay up late every night just to keep up, and my principal even commented that I seem disengaged in class. At home, I'm so completely drained that I've been skipping family get-togethers and barely talking to my husband in the evenings.
Has this period of feeling overwhelmed and struggling to function lasted for less than six months since the school changes began?
Yes, it has been going on for about five months now, ever since they rolled out all the changes at my school. So it has been just under six months, but the constant stress makes it feel much longer.
Since these changes began, have you experienced any periods where you felt completely back to your normal self, or has this emotional distress been present most of the time?

No, I haven't felt like my normal self at all; this distress has been constant. I feel trapped in a continuous state of work-related tension and an emotional roller coaster that just doesn't seem to stop. It has been present most of the time and spills into every part of my life.
